facts.business: E-Land Apparel Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and export of garments and related products.

auditor.name: Not stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern: The Company has incurred losses in the current and prior years, and its net worth is eroded. The auditor has drawn attention to Note 43 which states the holding company has confirmed financial support to continue as a going concern.

key_risks: Going concern risk due to accumulated losses and eroded net worth, dependent on holding company financial support
Revenue recognition risk involving significant management judgement on timing of transfer of control
Declining operational income (Rs. 26,099.70 lakhs in FY26 vs Rs. 30,039.21 lakhs in FY25)
Increasing expenses (Rs. 31,393.40 lakhs in FY26 vs Rs. 30,006.67 lakhs in FY25) leading to losses
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during the year were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. Prior omnibus approval obtained from Audit Committee for FY 2025-26. Transactions reviewed quarterly. Form AOC-2 annexed. No pecuniary relationships of Directors/KMPs with potential conflict. No loans/advances to subsidiaries/associates as none exist.
